import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { currentWays } from "./current_ways";
import { currentNodes } from "./current_nodes";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to current_ways (its only foreign key inside the primary key) and nothing else references it.
export const currentWayNodes = defineTable("current_way_nodes", {
    columns: {
        wayId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        nodeId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        sequenceId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey()
    },
    relations: {
        way: rel.belongsTo(() => currentWays, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        node: rel.belongsTo(() => currentNodes, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
